coordinates: native decoded image pixels; xyxy boxes are half-open
mask_geometry: visible instance raster/RLE or multipart polygon; retain holes and disconnected parts
training_gate: Source and independent validation/test groups fixed; class identity and mask boundaries reviewed; every target in evaluated view covered; export/import geometry verified
unknown_policy: unresolved is not a confirmed non-target; never silently turn unknown targets into empty negative labels
test_label_policy: no predictions from the evaluated model used as ground truth
counting_policy: Report original image annotations, repeated tile exposures and unique physical component identities separately
